business_summary: COL Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the provision of digital reading products, publishing operation, and content value-added services in China and internationally. The company sources licensed digital content through its online platform, authors, and copyright agencies; and distributes digital reading products to various terminals, platforms, and media outlets. It also focuses on literature IP, as well as creates various derivative forms of web fiction, including audiobooks, short and medium drama series, animation, film, and merchandise. In addition, the company owns platforms that produce original content, such as 17K.com, 4YT.Net, science fiction label under the qixiangyuzhou name, and thriller label under the Mystery Project brand name. The company was formerly known as COL Digital Publishing Group Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to COL Group Co.,Ltd. in April 2023. COL Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Beijing, China.
